evidence_policy: Only committed real events and hash-verified artifacts from this new authorized Attempt. Missing evidence is unavailable/not_run, never inferred as success. No old terminal evidence or fixture outcome can satisfy new real acceptance.

not_found_observation.observed_definition: A later real model request contains the exact committed not_found receipt/status/path/reference in its prompt artifact, with matching source/binding and call identity. A receipt without a subsequent real request does not count. This proves delivery in model input, not hidden reasoning.
not_found_observation.no_applicable_missing_read: not_observed; do not silently pass coverage or buy another round

patch.successful_application_definition: Real OCI apply_patch succeeded, approved path only, resulting persisted snapshot/diff and source hash verified. A model patch proposal or self summary does not count.

latest_source_verify.pass_definition: All four exact approved commands pass under the latest frozen source; source hashes and exported diff/attempt/contract provenance agree. Source changes invalidate earlier Verify.

independent_review.pass_definition: Verified independent ReviewRun consumes this Attempt latest diff and Verify evidence with valid invocation and hashes. Coder finish/self summary cannot satisfy Review. Stop before human final acceptance.

blocker_and_recovery.rule: Preserve true executed receipts and spending. Safe terminal is not automatically resumed. No new paid round, retry outside existing bounds, budget refund or old authority reuse.

budget_and_legacy.rule: All original per-run/Review caps retained. Old Plan11/12/13 histories, spending and holds immutable. Push/PR/comments/publication forbidden.

fixture_and_platform_disclosure: Offline checks and macOS arm64/OrbStack OCI evidence are prerequisites only. Native Linux amd64 remains not_run; HR4/HR5 remain open.
